top_categories.workout_context: 93ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Rooted Vermont, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Rooted Vermont's Vermont mountains, Rolling to mountainous gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 86 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Rooted Vermont. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Rooted Vermont's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before race day.
8,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
At mile 60 of 86, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Rooted Vermont, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
8,000ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Low-cadence force work for 8,000ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 86 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on Vermont rolling to mountainous gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Rooted Vermont’s 86 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Rooted Vermont requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on vermont rolling to mountainous gravel to build confidence. Expect: vermont mountains, rolling to mountainous gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 86 miles of vermont rolling to mountainous gravel in Richmond, Vermont.
